standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 716-723)

core_obligations: Rewrite the diagonal of the base change: it is the base change of the original diagonal along the canonical morphism between the squares (proof lines 709-715)

Conclude: each separation axiom is defined by a property of the diagonal, and each of those properties is stable under base change, so the base-changed morphism satisfies the same axiom (proof lines 716-723)
proof_roadmap: Δ_{f'} 是 Δ_f 沿 X' ×_{Y'} X' → X ×_Y X 的基变换。
各分离公理按定义就是对 Δ 的某种性质的要求，而这些性质在基变换下稳定 ⇒ 结论。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every separation axiom for a morphism of algebraic stacks is stable under base change (author lemma at source lines 702-707, label lemma-base-change-separated). The proof (source lines 709-724) rewrites the diagonal of the base change as a base change of the original diagonal and applies the stability under base change of the properties defining the axioms (proof lines 709-723). The rewriting of the diagonal is the substance. H3.
